<thought>Using the DBE formula DBE = (2C + 2 - H)/2 (oxygen does not affect the count), for C11H13O3 we have DBE = (2*11 + 2 - 13)/2 = (22 + 2 - 13)/2 = 11/2 = 5.5, which rounds to the nearest whole number of 6 as the degree of unsaturation must be an integer.</thought>
<final_answer>6</final_answer>
